title: Serfauser Sauser Action Zipline Serfaus
name: Serfauser Sauser Action Zipline Serfaus
kurzbeschreibung: The Serfauser Sauser in Serfaus: over 2,000 m long high-alpine zipline in 4 sections reaching up to 65 km/h and flying up to 85 m above the treetops.
beschreibung:
Overview

The spectacular Serfauser Sauser is one of the longest and most thrilling high-alpine ziplines in the Alps, located in the popular holiday region Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis on the sunny high plateau above the Tyrolean Oberinntal (Landeck district). Starting from the mountain station of the Sunliner at an elevation of around 2,090 meters, thrill-seekers glide along a taut steel cable across four exhilarating flight sections spanning a total distance of over 2,000 meters down to the valley station of the Komperdellbahn in Serfaus.

Four Flight Sections & Weightlessness

Equipped with a specialized climbing harness, helmet, and professional safety pulley, participants clip into the cable and soar downhill like an eagle. At top speeds, flyers reach up to 65 kilometers per hour while gliding up to 85 meters above deep ravines, ski slopes, and dense Swiss stone pine forests. The four sections (Warm-up, Panorama Flight, Steep Flight, and Finale) deliver an unparalleled sensation of freedom and weightlessness against the breathtaking backdrop of the glaciated three-thousanders of the Samnaungruppe. Trained safety personnel at all four stations ensure smooth and secure clipping and unclipping procedures.

Visit & Getting There

The Serfauser Sauser is open daily during the summer season of Bergbahnen Serfaus from mid-June to mid-October from 09:00 to 16:30 (minimum body weight 30 kg, maximum weight 125 kg, minimum height 1.30 m). Ticket prices for the zipline flight including safety equipment (as of the 2025/2026 season): adults approx. €39.00, youth (born 2007–2010) approx. €34.00, children (born up to 2011) approx. €24.00. The ascent to the starting point is via the Sunliner-Gondelbahn. Getting there: Via the B180 to Ried, then continue on the L19 to Serfaus; a large parking garage is available at the village entrance (Serfaus itself is traffic-calmed). The free underground Dorfbahn Serfaus takes you directly to the cable car valley station in just a few minutes.

Tips

Sturdy, closed-toe shoes and sporty, windproof clothing are mandatory for the flight (no open sandals or skirts/dresses). Advance reservations at the Komperdellbahn ticket counters are strongly recommended on sunny peak summer days to avoid waiting times.
